purpose: Granular milestone truth beneath the strategic Phase A-F roadmap. This is the only machine-readable milestone register. Future milestone IDs may be refined by Manager only by updating this file; strategic phases are not deleted.

strategicRoadmap.rule: Phase A-F remains the strategic roadmap. This register adds implementation-sized milestones and does not replace the phases.

sequence: verify each agent branch and focused evidence
reconcile backend contract and frontend consumption
classify mechanical, contract, architecture and scope conflicts
run shared alignment and full relevant gates
validate merge candidate against protected main
mergeProtocol.completionRule: An agent branch can be complete without the milestone being complete. P2.13 becomes complete only on reconciled, verified protected main.

milestones.title: Reconciliation / foundation cleanup
deliverables: stale counts and status contradictions corrected
milestones.implementationBoundary: Historical foundation and reconciliation only. No P2.12 Skill or P2.13 Context & Session implementation is attributed to P2.11.
decisionDependencies: XA-8 through XA-18 remain manager decisions where applicable
completionCriteria: generated and curated documentation roles are explicit

finishEvidence.role: historical completion evidence; not current state

milestones.currentCommitReference: historical evidence only; do not treat as current main

milestones.title: Skill
deliverables: four published operations: skill.list, skill.resolve, skill.describe, skill.validate-selection
milestones.implementationBoundary: Skill registration, discovery, validation and lifecycle. No Skill procedure execution, no Agent Machine, no Memory store, no provider/runtime integration.

milestones.title: Context & Session
deliverables: backend tests and frontend contract consumption
milestones.implementationBoundary: Context/session lifecycle, snapshots, references, compaction bookkeeping, checksum lineage, rollover, continuation serialization, rehydration, verification, bounded local state and presentation. Context is not Conversation, Session is not Context Window, Memory is not Context, and Execution is not implemented here.
decisionDependencies: no new XA row for implementation drift
Manager reconciliation PASS and MERGE PASS are required
completionCriteria: one Context & Session LEGO with no duplicate domain
locked contracts and exact frontend/backend vocabulary
context/session lifecycle and fail-closed invalid transitions
frontend shows explicit continuation/degraded/failure states without fabricated tokens

startEvidence.role: P2.12 protected-main baseline and Agent 2 implementation start

finishEvidence.reference: pending Manager reconciliation; agent-2 evidence is branch-local until reconciliation
finishEvidence.role: not complete until protected-main merge and post-merge verification

reconciliation.conflict: Agent 1 Context & Session frontend-consumption branch is unavailable for the mandatory two-branch comparison.
reconciliation.contract: ai.context@1.0.0 and ai.agent-session@1.0.0 backend contract rows are present on Agent 2; frontend consumption alignment cannot be verified without Agent 1 branch.
reconciliation.reason: The registered ref arena/01a0c6b4-n8n-rust-v-4 is not present locally or in origin refs; only the Agent 2 working ref is available.
reconciliation.requiredDecision: Manager must provide or restore the Agent 1 ref, then rerun reconciliation against the same protected baseline before any merge approval.
reconciliation.blockingTest: Agent 1 focused Context & Session tests plus cross-agent alignment tests cannot run until the Agent 1 branch/ref is available.
reconciliation.evidence: git show-ref / git ls-remote origin: registered Agent 1 ref absent; Agent 2 focused tests and shared gates pass independently.

milestones.title: Memory
deliverables: persistent memory contract and implementation plan
milestones.implementationBoundary: Memory survives context replacement. It is not part of P2.13 and must not be smuggled into context/session state.
completionCriteria: Manager publishes a canonical memory contract and explicit provider boundary

milestones.title: Workspace
milestones.implementationBoundary: Workspace runtime and filesystem/terminal authority are not implemented in P2.13.
decisionDependencies: workspace ownership and AI extension decision
completionCriteria: scope and authority boundaries are explicit

milestones.title: Agent Machine / execution foundation
deliverables: Agent Machine contract and execution foundation, subject to dependency readiness
milestones.implementationBoundary: P2.13 provides foundations only. It does not implement the Agent Machine loop or multi-agent runtime.
decisionDependencies: Agent Machine contract and execution ownership
completionCriteria: dependencies are ready and execution loop is separately scoped

milestones.title: Later capability ladder
deliverables: Phase C Artifact / Approval / MCP / Runtime Adapter
Phase D Work Trace / Node Creator / Translation / Token & Usage
milestones.implementationBoundary: Future ladder only. Exact future numbering can be split or refined by Manager when implementation evidence requires it, but only by updating this canonical register.
completionCriteria: each future milestone gets its own evidence before status changes
